title: RAW optimizations
description: squeeze as much fps as possible out of 1.20.1 without being unplayable.
body:
this pack is different from other optimization modpacks in that it does not bother to preserve any graphics or render distance, and has exclusively mods to optimize the game.

its best use cases are for low end pcs or those who do not care about the graphics of their game, and simply want raw performance.
